title: Cost Sculptor: role-aware token analytics canvas & export patterns
creator: Aditi Rao
description: Problem: Customers need a way to investigate token-level cost drivers across teams and export defensible artifacts for chargeback and audit. Scope: a dashboard canvas that supports multi-dimensional slicing (time, model variant, route, user/team, prompt template), in-context token preview, time-weighted attribution, and an export wizard that preserves token context and attribution metadata. Proposed UI components: 1) Sculptor Canvas: a grid of microtiles representing token groups with sparkline cost, median latency, and attribution tag overlays; 2) Attribution Lanes: stacked charts that show how token cost maps to features (system prompts, user messages, tool calls) with delta baseline comparisons; 3) Role Filters & Presets: saved views for Billing Owner, Platform Engineer, Product Manager with default aggregation levels; 4) Export Wizard: stepper for format (CSV, NDJSON, Parquet), scope (selected tiles / time window / route), anonymization options, and attachable audit metadata. Constraints: must respect PII minimization and KMS encryption rules for exports, and load quickly for up to 50k tokens by progressive aggregation. Success metrics: adoption of export feature by top 10 customers in pilot, reduction in billing disputes on token split by 30%.
acceptance_criteria: Visual spec for Sculptor Canvas delivered in Figma with responsive states and accessibility colours
Clickable Figma prototype demonstrating: tile selection, lane drilling, role presets, and export wizard flow
Export artifact examples included: sample CSV and NDJSON with token-level context and provenance fields
Design notes captured for privacy knobs: token redaction, KMS tag inclusion, and retention TTL
Handoff doc with front-end component spec and data contract (fields, example rows) added to Confluence
decisions: Default aggregation level will be 'message-group' (to limit data size) with an option to expand to raw tokens
NDJSON will be the canonical export format for token-level exports because it preserves nested attribution while remaining streamable
Role presets will be configurable via Console settings; initial shipped set: Billing Owner, Platform Eng, Product PM
Microtiles will show up to 100 tiles by default with a 'More' progressive-load control to avoid cold-load latency
tradeoffs: Showing raw tokens by default increases cognitive load and export size; compromise: aggregated view first, clear CTA to expand
Adding full token preview in the console increases risk of exposing sensitive user content; mitigation via redaction toggle and policy tag
NDJSON preserves structure but is less friendly to non-technical billing users — provide CSV export with flattened summary rows as a convenience
